title: Pivotality via the two coordinate values
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\beta$ be any function, let $i$ be a coordinate, and let $x\in\{\pm1\}^n$. The function is pivotal at $x$ in coordinate $i$ if and only if its values at the two inputs obtained from $x$ by setting coordinate $i$ to $+1$ and to $-1$ are different.
hypotheses_covered: Function f from the n-dimensional sign cube to an arbitrary type β
